}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "KICKPI K5C_V1.2" is on top of board.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Allwinner]] A133 @1.6GHz :Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A53) *GPU: ''Imagination PowerVR GE8300'', supports :OpenGL ES 3.2, OpenCL 1.2, Vulkan 1.0 *Onboard Storage: 8GB eMMC 5.1 Flash, :TF card (max. 128GB) / MMC card slot *Memory: 2GB (DDR3) SDRAM (4x [[Samsung]]) *Wi-Fi: [[AIC]] AIC8800D40L ([[Allwinner]] AW869A) :802.11abgn/ac/ax (2.4/5GHz), BT 5.4 BLE *USB: 2x USB 2.0, 1x USB 2.0 Type-C (OTG) ports *PCIe: 1x mPCIe slot *Network: 1x 1GbE port *GPIO: 1x 30-pin connector *Power: 12V/1A via barrel, :or 5V via USB Type-C (OTG), :or 3.4V LiPo battery
